beats.say: This animal has three hearts, and blue blood.
The common octopus. Eight arms, covered in suckers.
Two hearts pump blood through its gills. The third pumps it around the body.
And that third heart stops beating when it swims. So it would rather crawl.
Its blood is blue, because it's built on copper, not iron.
And most of its brain isn't even in its head.
